title: ReapRequest
description:
Request payload for [`METHOD_ENVIRONMENT_REAP`]. With no fields set, reap
deletes only dead nodes (always safe — a live node is never dead).

all.description: Also reap non-dead nodes that have no live owning run (needs `force`).

dry_run.description: Report what WOULD be reaped without deleting anything.

force.description:
Required alongside `all` — guards a fresh (no-liveness) reaper from
treating every healthy node as an orphan.

older_than_secs.description: Only reap nodes at least this many seconds old.
